html:
A Chinese revolutionary who led the movement to overthrow the Qing dynasty and became the first president of the Republic of China. Both Taiwan and mainland China honour him as the father of modern China.

Born to a farming family in Guangdong, he was schooled in Hawaii and trained as a doctor in Hong Kong. In 1894 he founded his first revolutionary society. After a failed uprising he lived mostly in exile, raising money from overseas Chinese. In 1905 in Tokyo he formed the Revolutionary Alliance.

His ideas were the Three Principles of the People: nationalism, democracy and the people's livelihood.

When the Xinhai Revolution broke out in 1911, Sun hurried home and was made provisional president in January 1912. He soon gave way to the general Yuan Shikai, who could force the emperor out. China then fell into rule by warlords. Sun built a base in Guangzhou, led the Kuomintang, and took Soviet help, allying with the new Communist Party. He died of cancer in 1925. His follower Chiang Kai-shek took over the party.
sum: A Chinese revolutionary who led the movement to overthrow the Qing dynasty and became the first president of the Republic of China. Both Taiwan and mainland China honour him as the father of modern China.
